jobgether-jobgether:lever:762b94c4-e5b8-.title: IT Developer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:762b94c4-e5b8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Developer based in India. This role offers the opportunity to own the end-to-end development and maintenance of web applications, internal systems, and technical platforms. You will work across both front-end and back-end development while building integrations, automating workflows, and resolving technical issues. The position combines hands-on software development with systems management, data analysis, and cross-functional technical support. You’ll collaborate with marketing, operations, leadership, and other teams to turn business needs into practical technology solutions. The role also involves improving system reliability, documenting technical processes, and helping teams adopt tools and workflows effectively. You’ll work independently in a remote environment where adaptability, organization, and strong problem-solving skills are highly valued. This is a strong opportunity for a versatile developer who enjoys working across technologies and taking ownership of diverse technical challenges. Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot web applications, internal tools, and integrations across multiple platforms. Build and maintain front-end interfaces, back-end logic, APIs, and database connections. Manage and optimize CMS platforms, particularly WordPress, with a focus on scalability, security, and performance. Implement API integrations and database connectivity solutions between business systems. Use automation platforms such as Zapier to streamline workflows and improve operational efficiency. Support and maintain a broad range of business applications and software platforms used across the organization. Analyze data and create charts, dashboards, and visualizations to support business decision-making. Use advanced Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools to process, analyze, and present data effectively. Troubleshoot technical issues across web platforms, systems, integrations, and workflows while identifying opportunities for optimization. Maintain appropriate security practices, including antivirus, firewall, and two-factor authentication controls. Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions. Provide technical guidance, mentorship, training, and knowledge sharing to team members when needed. Document systems, architecture, processes, and workflows to improve accessibility and continuity across teams. Contribute to onboarding, process improvements, system optimization, and ad-hoc technical initiatives. Requirements Proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript, SQL, and Python . Experience using GitHub and modern version control workflows. Basic understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and software development best practices. Familiarity with both front-end and back-end development, APIs, databases, and system integrations. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities. Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex workflows. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment. Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, tools, and processes quickly. Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to identifying technical and operational improvements. Ability to provide support, documentation, and training to colleagues when required. Access to a computer with a dual-monitor setup and at least 8 GB of RAM . Reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps . Camera with at least 1080p resolution . Benefits Full-time schedule of 40 hours per week , 8 hours per day. Competitive base salary. Permanent work-from-home arrangement. Monday-to-Friday work

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7a535b38-9ced-.title: Product Owner
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7a535b38-9ced-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner based in Belgium. This is a fully remote Product Owner role focused on connecting client needs, business objectives, and technical execution. You will own the product lifecycle from discovery and roadmap definition through continuous iteration and improvement. A major part of the role involves building trusted client relationships from initial conversations through long-term partnerships. You’ll translate business requirements into clear product direction while collaborating closely with developers and AI-assisted tools. The position combines product strategy, stakeholder management, consultative communication, and account growth. You’ll work within a highly distributed international environment alongside professionals across multiple countries and time zones. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership while enjoying significant flexibility over where and how you work. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, delivery, and iteration based on client, user, and market feedback. Lead client interactions from initial discussions and onboarding through ongoing account management, building relationships that support long-term partnerships. Translate client needs, business objectives, and user feedback into clear product requirements and actionable priorities for development teams. Collaborate with engineers and AI-assisted tools to define solutions, clarify requirements, and support effective product delivery. Build prototypes and contribute to product strategy, helping stakeholders visualize solutions and align around product direction. Communicate product value in a consultative manner by educating and advising clients rather than relying on a transactional sales approach. Proactively engage existing accounts to identify issues early, manage expectations, gather feedback, and uncover opportunities for renewal and expansion. Develop strong, trusted relationships that contribute to retention, account growth, and referrals. Collect, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from clients, users, internal stakeholders, and market signals to continuously improve the product roadmap. Bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring product priorities and business objectives remain aligned throughout the development process. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, prioritizing features, and working with development teams. Proven experience in a client-facing role involving business development, sales, account management, or consultative relationship building. Demonstrated ability to retain and grow customer accounts over time, rather than focusing solely on new business acquisition. Strong client relationship-building skills and a consultative, customer-first approach. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Native or near-native proficiency in spoken and written English. Experience building prototypes and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product strategies and requirements. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and incorporating emerging technologies into product development workflows. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully distributed, international team across multiple time zones. Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success. Nice to have: Previous sales experience, particularly in a consultative environment. Nice to have: Experience working directly with clients in the United States. Benefits: Fully

jobgether-jobgether:lever:82f2ebd5-2e4c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Fintech Program Manager based in the United States. This role leads the design and delivery of technical integrations between financial technology partners and a banking technology environment. You will serve as a key bridge between fintech partners, IT, operations, compliance, risk, and partnership teams. The position combines integration architecture, program management, implementation, and strategic relationship ownership. You will create repeatable standards, onboarding processes, technical documentation, and integration patterns that enable scalable growth. The role also supports complex payment rails, regulated financial programs, and partnerships in high-risk industries. Success requires strong technical fluency, financial services knowledge, and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions. You will have the opportunity to shape innovative banking partnerships while helping build secure, compliant, and scalable fintech programs. Lead the design and implementation of technical integrations connecting fintech partners with banking platforms, APIs, file-based interfaces, and payment rails. Develop integration architectures, data mappings, solution documentation, file specifications, validation standards, and partner-facing technical requirements. Build and maintain standardized integration patterns, onboarding playbooks, technical specifications, checklists, and process documentation to make partner implementations faster and lower risk. Own end-to-end technical onboarding for assigned partnerships, coordinating implementation plans, dependencies, testing, UAT, go-live readiness, and launch activities. Coordinate connectivity, file-feed validation, funds-flow requirements, and payment-rail enablement across ACH, wire, RTP, and FedNow. Partner with Fintech Operations, IT, Compliance, BSA, Risk, and other internal teams to resolve technical, operational, regulatory, and reconciliation requirements. Support third-party risk management, due diligence, account structuring, and ongoing oversight activities for fintech partnerships. Contribute technical and feasibility expertise to prospective partnership discussions, business cases, deal structuring, and pipeline development. Serve as the ongoing relationship owner for assigned partnerships, conducting business reviews and identifying opportunities for integration improvements and expansion. Represent the organization at selected industry conferences, partner meetings, site visits, and other business events, with approximately 15–25% travel as needed. Support banking programs involving cannabis-related businesses, money services businesses, and other higher-risk industries, including enhanced due diligence and regulatory requirements. Monitor evolving regulatory and industry developments affecting fintech, payments, cannabis banking, and other high-risk verticals, advising stakeholders on potential program implications. Continuously improve integration standards, documentation, onboarding processes, and program practices based on implementation experience and emerging best practices. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. 5+ years of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or financial services, particularly across implementation, solutions/integration, program management, or partnership functions. Demonstrated experience designing or coordinating technical integrations involving APIs, file-based interfaces, data exchanges, or similar technologies. Ability to lead technical discussions with partners and translate complex technology requirements into practical, partner-facing solutions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a0ed2cbd-5b0a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will own the Enterprise narrative, messaging, content, and sales enablement strategy across complex buying journeys. The role requires a deep understanding of sophisticated buying committees, longer sales cycles, and high-stakes commercial decisions.
